entities.summary: Brittney Sykes is an American professional basketball player with the Seattle Storm of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for the Laces of Unrivaled. She was drafted with the seventh overall pick in the 2017 WNBA draft. Her nickname is "Slim".
